# Marketing with Asmat

> Performance marketer for United States DTC brands and lead gen businesses. Meta Ads, Google Ads, creative, funnels, tracking, and CRM follow-up. One person owns the path from click to sale.

Asmat helps brands selling in the United States. Most e-commerce clients are on Shopify: women's apparel, skincare, beauty, and jewelry. Lead gen clients are B2B and B2C companies that need qualified calls, not cheap form fills.

Proof: 7+ years, $20M+ ad spend managed, Top Rated Plus on Upwork, Meta and Google certified.
